description: An actual shared formula can be restricted to the finite subtype of exactly its occurring free variable names, retaining its terms and logical constructors.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.finiteRestriction.{u, v, a} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {α : Type a}
  [DecidableEq α] (A : L.Formula α) : L.Formula ↥(FirstOrder.Language.BoundedFormula.freeVarFinset A)
